Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in genealogical reasoning by misidentifying the paternal grandfather. In Step 10, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the paternal grandfather is "Charles Louis Bretagne de La Tr mo lle, the 6th Duke of Thouars." This is factually wrong because the 6th Duke is the *great-grandfather* of the subject (Charles Bretagne Marie de La Tr mo lle, the 9th Duke). The correct paternal grandfather is the 7th Duke, Charles Armand Ren  de La Tr mo lle. The error stems from a failure to correctly map the lineage hierarchy: the Planner confused the father of the 7th Duke (the 6th Duke) with the father of the 8th Duke (the 7th Duke). Despite the WebSurfer providing clear evidence in Step 9 that the 7th Duke's father was the 6th Duke, the Planner failed to synthesize this correctly, instead skipping a generation in the lineage chain.
